title: Efficient inference on high-dimensional linear models with missing outcomes

split.decision: Dense beta norm 5, e100, n900 d1000 MAR(23). Public val seeds 1..8, no cross-instance training. Hidden fresh independent data seeds, opaque shuffled ids; materialized observations only. Fitting uses independent BENCH_SEED algorithm stream.

baseline.paper_ref: Manifest 0.937 is an indexing/metric mismatch; matching published e100 dense 1SE CI length 0.870; reproduced mean 0.8782661040144949.

allowed_changes: Outcome/propensity nuisance estimators, working models, surrogate losses, debiasing and uncertainty methods, regularization and numerical solvers may change.
The scaled-Lasso pilot, propensity logistic model, CV grids and 1SE rule are baseline estimators, not a different posterior/parameter target.

When retaining the supplied scaled-Lasso, logistic-propensity and debiasing pipeline, changing only lam0='univ', the 40-point propensity grid, the 41-point gamma/n grid, the 5-fold splits or the submitted 1SE rule does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Construct shorter valid 95% confidence intervals for the fixed conditional mean m(e100) in the dense high-dimensional missing-outcome linear-model experiment.
The conditional-mean estimand, query e100, dense-coefficient generating design, n=900/d=1000, MAR mask and supplied observed outcomes are fixed.
The normal-multiplier interval convention, mean length, coverage threshold .95-2*sqrt(.0475/M), full instance set and independent-instance inference remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not change the target to another query, marginal mean or alternative coefficient model; treat missing zeros as observed responses; or substitute known true coefficients/mean.
No extra simulated datasets, hidden seeds, cross-instance fitting or modified data/metric.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
Multiplying `sigma_hat` or `asym_se` by a constant, or any other fixed rescaling of interval width, also does not count.

Dense e100 cell governs the selected task despite sparse descriptor elsewhere.

research_contract_review.verification_scope: Task-specific research-scope review and bounded checks; not a new performance/readiness certification.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
